channel.title: Forever Held · Memorial printables
channel.description: Gentle memorial printables and planning ideas from Forever Held.

item.title: Celebration of Life Welcome Sign Template — Three Sizes Included
item.description: Every venue is different. The Soft Botanical kit gives you all three welcome sign sizes in one download so you can print the one that fits your entryway. Fill in the free Adobe Reader app, save, and print at a local shop.

item.title: Thanksgiving Memory Cards — Printable Share-a-Memory for the Holiday Table
item.description: The first holiday without them is hard. Tuck a share-a-memory card into each place setting so family can write a favorite story between courses. Cards print four per letter page, match the program and welcome sign.

item.title: How to Add Photos to a Fill-In PDF Funeral Program — Desktop Tutorial
item.description: Photos go in on a computer. Open the PDF in free Adobe Acrobat Reader, click the photo box, choose your file, and it drops in perfectly sized. Print a test page at home, then send the final to your print shop.

item.title: Funeral program, welcome sign and memory cards you can print tonight
item.description: A gentle botanical memorial suite you fill in yourself: funeral program, welcome sign and share-a-memory cards. Edit on your phone with the free Adobe Acrobat Reader app and print the same day. $12.99 instant download, nothing to ship.

item.title: Helping a friend plan a celebration of life? Start with the welcome sign
item.description: A matching funeral program, welcome sign and share-a-memory cards in soft sage and cream. Type the name and dates on your phone with the free Adobe Acrobat Reader app, then print at home or at a print shop the same day. $12.99 instant download.

item.title: Share a memory cards for a funeral or celebration of life
item.description: Give guests a gentle way to share a favorite memory. These editable cards print four to a letter sheet and match the program and welcome sign in the Soft Botanical suite.

item.title: What to include in a funeral program (with an editable template)
item.description: Cover, order of service, life story and a thank-you panel: our folded funeral program has a place for each. Type it on your phone and print on US Letter cardstock.

item.title: Celebration of life welcome sign you can edit on your phone
item.description: Type your loved one's name and dates into this soft botanical welcome sign, then have a print shop mount it on foam board, often the same day. Prints at 24 x 36, 16 x 24 or 12 x 18 in.

item.title: Free funeral planning checklist for families and friends
item.description: Planning a service for someone you love? Our free checklist walks you through the first days gently, and our matching memorial printables are there when you need them.
